direction: Round domed magical gemstones, selective internal crystalline reflections, thin antique metal bezel; red, green, blue, gold and purple; shared silhouette and metal.

generation.prompt: Image1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Create ONE original fantasy RPG inventory gem icon inspired by its restrained circular domed jewels. One deep ruby-red magical stone, almost perfectly round, straight-on front view, softly convex glossy cabochon surface. A thin aged dark-bronze and oxidized-silver bezel follows the circular edge, a few very small elegant clasp details at top and bottom. The colored stone occupies at least85percent of the object's diameter; metal remains delicate. Rich dark-red depth inside, some subtle angular crystalline structures UNDER the smooth glass surface, a brighter translucent ruby core, dark quiet lower facets, one localized warm-white reflection at upper-left. Painterly high-quality western fantasy item art, tactile and dignified, not modern jewelry product photography. The silhouette is round and regular, no long points, no star outline. Crucially avoid dense kaleidoscope diamond facets and uniform glitter: broad quiet surfaces, deep interior and selective highlights like the reference. No text, letters, symbols, watermark, pedestal, shadow card, colored background, external aura or extra items. Actual transparent alpha background. Entire single jewel centered in a square canvas with about14percent clear margin all sides, consistent top-left lighting. Ruby body should remain true deep red; bezel dark antique metal so deterministic gemstone-only recoloring can preserve its metal. This is a production icon for44to64px display; keep small metal details readable and restrained.
